name: confirm_primary_and_metadata

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,hashlib
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','inputs/sources/contraction.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
print('Cached PDF conversion matches copied text:',r.stdout==Path('inputs/sources/contraction.txt').read_text())
print('Reservation SHA:',hashlib.sha256(Path('reservation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
s=Path('sources/companion.txt').read_text();print(s[s.index('Theorem 2.6'):s.index('2.2    Dom-chromatic')])
print('companion remaining body not relied on:',len(s)-28000,'characters')

print('denial metadata',Path('inherited-denials.json').read_text()[:2000])
